faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Direct answers to key prospective-student questions.

questions.question: How does the programme assess student code when AI coding assistants are permitted?
questions.answer: Assessments evaluate conceptual understanding, architectural reasoning, and defensive engineering rather than rote syntax. Students are evaluated on their ability to explain system trade-offs, identify edge cases in AI outputs, debug complex failures, and defend architectural choices in code reviews.

questions.question: What is the role of CETLS in my day-to-day learning?
questions.answer: The Centre for Educational Technology & Learning Sciences (CETLS) at IIIT Hyderabad uses learning analytics and educational psychology to continuously refine MSIT's active learning environments, ensuring instructional methods deliver deep conceptual mastery.

questions.question: How is the industry co-op structured and supervised?
questions.answer: Students work inside corporate engineering teams for approximately half the programme. The co-op is jointly supervised by industry engineering mentors and IIIT-H academic advisors, with regular milestones and code evaluations.

questions.question: Is the industry co-op paid by host companies?
questions.answer: Corporate co-op engagements typically offer competitive company stipends based on industry standards, helping offset living and educational expenses during the internship tenure.

questions.question: Can final-year undergraduate students apply for the January 2027 intake?
questions.answer: Yes. Students completing their final undergraduate examinations before January 2027 are eligible to apply provisionally, subject to producing degree completion certificates upon joining.

questions.question: Can candidates from non-computer science engineering branches apply?
questions.answer: Yes. Candidates with engineering degrees outside CS (e.g., ECE, EEE, Mechanical) are welcome. Phase 01 Foundations provides an intensive bridge to master data structures, systems, and algorithms.

questions.question: How does MSIT differ from a traditional M.Tech degree?
questions.answer: Traditional M.Tech programs focus predominantly on classroom lectures and academic research theses. MSIT emphasizes active studio problem-solving, deep modern AI systems, and approximately half the programme spent in corporate industry co-op.
